adds.title: Hawaii Constitutional Amendment 2 (1998) and 2024 repeal referendum
adds.summary: Hawaii's 1998 constitutional provision authorizing the legislature to reserve marriage to opposite-sex couples was superseded by the 2013 Hawaii Marriage Equality Act allowing same-sex marriage and was repealed by voter approval on November 5, 2024 with 55.94% voting yes to delete Article I Section 23's opposite-sex limitation, leaving marriage not restricted to opposite-sex couples under the state constitution while state law prohibits discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation and gender and gender identity and provides a 2022-established LGBTQ+ Commission on equal treatment.
